title: U.S. Bank Tower
visualBrief: Los Angeles granite-and-glass tower with mapped concentric/orthogonal setbacks, triangular window bays, folded stone/glass crown, landing roof and renovated lobby.

nativeAxes.origin: Ground-level mapped center at lower Fifth Street entrance datum

sourceFacts.architect: Pei Cobb Freed & Partners; Henry N. Cobb

reconstruction.massing: Exact-QID whole outline and eleven independent mapped tower parts determine the signed overlapping circular/orthogonal volumes. Architect structural isometric corroborates setback sequence.
reconstruction.facade: Original granite window surrounds with paired projecting glass panes and physical joints; fine bay spacing reconstructed from architect close photograph.
reconstruction.crown: Sixteen folded bays and circular landing roof reconstructed from architect axonometric and close photographs; current owner establishes rooftop use and new entrance.

geographicProposal.orientationConfidence: mapped setbacks with Fifth Street/library evidence

Signed heading 1.086317737338 retained: native +X northeast, +Z southeast. Lower Fifth Street entrance faces southwest on -X toward the library. Different circular and orthogonal setbacks retain their mapped signs; crown is centered on mapped highest part 495115500. Ground Y=0 is lower entry datum. Approximate mapped stages at 195/225/250/280/295 m support the architect isometric setback sequence; they are not surveyed floor sections. Accept 2 m footprint / 1 degree reconstruction allowance, automatic replacement disabled. Hill steps, terrain slope and exact doorway thresholds are unmeasured.

scaleBasis: Published owner/architect/contractor heights and distinguishing construction systems; map footprint for local orientation, with reconstructed details declared separately.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.
sourceLicense: Original reconstruction under repository license. Map-derived plan evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications are linked, not redistributed.
materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Original 130716-triangle, 15408960-byte master remains exactly reproducible from the unchanged world-tower recipe. Reviewed source and four browser levels preserve eleven mapped circular/orthogonal volumes, all setbacks, sixteen folded crown bays, glazed collar, closed circular landing roof and renewed ground lobby. Street/close-up retain reconstructed projecting triangular window profiles and long granite bands/piers; district flattens window projections and aggregates floors, skyline averages stone/glass coverage. Published 310.3 m tip and owner 30 ft (9.144 m) lobby follow current primary descriptions. Individual setback heights are approximate map data; architect isometric corroborates the ordering rather than survey dimensions. Owner/CVU count 72 stories while architect calls it 73; CVU completion 1990 differs from owner 1989. Crown phase/radii, bay spacing/projection, rail and canopy details remain reconstructions. Entrance canopy repair includes upward-facing opaque surfaces so it is visible from above; no interior transparency layer. Three shared 256 px graphs, zero embedded images. Tenant/roof lettering, flagpole and service furniture, interiors, separate Bunker Hill Steps/plaza landscape, parking and local sloped terrain are excluded. Native shaft allowances 1.5 / 0.75 / 0.3 / 0.1 m exclude omitted fine joints/reveals and distant canopy. No physical-device performance or surveyed grade claim. Close-up compresses the original 0.13 m window inset to 0.025 m, retaining the projecting bay peak and vertical reveals. Horizontal reveals merge into a continuous backing; street omits the shallow vertical reveals and aggregates three floor rows. These fine recess simplifications do not remove the main folded bay profile.
importReason: Preserve thin facade frames, panel joints and crown/antenna details until a measured LOD chain is authored.
